messages:
izzy (release lead): Need express approval to push tiny auth header hotfix to eu-west1. Cause: malformed header causing intermittent 401s. Patch trivial, unit + smoke passed. Request pin to api-gateway:v1.9.3-hotfix and fastpass.

deploy-bot: Deploy request logged: jobs/deploy-api/6543332222. Canary plan: 2% -> 20% -> 100% (5m windows). Auto-rollback enabled.

paul (oncall): oncall ack. paste rollback criteria pls.

izzy (release lead): Rollback if error rate > 0.8% for 3m OR auth failures spike > baseline by 5x. Nora to hold rollback.

nora (eng-sre): I approve conditional on tight gating. I'll add alert with 1m eval and be ready to cut traffic.

rene (prod-eng): I can perform the traffic steps. Start at 01:05 UTC.

kai (pm): customers impacted: one demo customer. I'll notify after 20% success. Approve.

deploy-bot: Canary 2% started: jobs/deploy-api/6543332222/c1. Logs: https://ci/reports/6543332222

paul (oncall): 2% looks clean. ok to bump.

deploy-bot: Promoted to 20% -> jobs/deploy-api/6543332222/c2.

nora (eng-sre): 20% window clear. No auth spike. rolling to 100%.

rene (prod-eng): 100% live. Metrics normal. Pin applied: api-gateway -> api-gateway:v1.9.3-hotfix (eu-west1).

kai (pm): Notified customer and ops. They confirm fix. Thanks.

izzy (release lead): Fastpass complete and successful. I'll add short note to release doc. Closing thread.
